title: Urology and Continence Supply Program return window and restocking terms
content:
Under Larkfield's patient supply terms for the Urology and Continence Supply Program, returns are governed on each tier by three terms: the return window, the restocking fee, and whether opened supplies may come back.

## Terms

- **Return window**: the window for requesting the return of unopened, sealed items, in calendar days counted from the carrier delivery date of the shipment.
- **Restocking fee**: the fee withheld from the credit for an accepted return, as a whole percent of the amount the customer paid for the returned units.
- **Opened supplies returnable**: whether opened medical supplies may be returned for credit.

## Terms by tier

| Basis | Continence Self-Pay Program | Continence Commercial HMO Program | Continence Commercial PPO Program | Continence Medicare Advantage Program | Continence Original Medicare Program | Continence Medicaid Program |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Return window (days from delivery) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Restocking fee (percent of the amount paid) | 15 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent |
| Opened supplies returnable | No | No | No | No | No | No |


## Points of reading

- Opened supplies are not returnable for credit on any tier.
- Only the Continence Self-Pay Program shows a restocking fee, 15 percent. **Hypothetical return:** if the customer paid 40.00 USD for the returned units, 15 percent of that is 6.00 USD, so 6.00 USD is withheld.
